name: Dragon, Corruptor
body:
CORRUPTOR DRAGON, VERY YOUNG
CR 4

The corruptor dragon’s eyes and permanent scowl exude a calculated malice, and her putrid green scales radiate the smell of earthy decay.

XP 1,200
LE Small dragon (corruptor)
Init +0; Senses dragon senses; Perception +0

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 11, flat-footed 16 (+5 natural, +1 size)
hp 42 (5d12+10)
Fort +5, Ref +4, Will +5
Immune negative energy, paralysis, sleep

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., fly 150 ft. (average)
Melee bite +7 (1d6+1), 2 claws +7 (1d4+1)
Special Attacks breath weapon (20-ft. cone, DC 12, 4d4 negative energy, once per 1d4 rounds)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 5th; concentration +9)

2nd (5/day)—barkskin, stone call
1st (7/day)—charm animal (DC 15), entangle (DC 15), goodberry, touch of bloodletting (DC 15)
0 (at will)—create water, detect poison, guidance, know direction, resistance, spark

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 11, Con 13, Int 10, Wis 15, Cha 18
Base Atk +5; CMB +5; CMD 15 (19 vs. trip)
Feats Improved Natural Armor, Skill Focus (survival), Toughness
Skills Craft (alchemy) +8), Fly +8, Handle Animal +9, Heal +10, Knowledge (nature) +8, Stealth +4, Survival +10
Languages Draconic, Common

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Dragon Senses (Ex)

Dragons have darkvision 120 ft. and blindsense 60 ft. They see four times as well as a human in dim light and twice as well in normal light.
